item.title: GALLERY | Wrexham AFC 2-1 Portsmouth FC
item.description: Wrexham AFC followed up an excellent first-half display with a gritty second 45 on a night under the STōK Cae Ras floodlights that cemented the hosts’ place in the play-off places thanks to victory against Portsmouth. Sam Smith opened the scoring with a sublime 23rd-minute header to put the Red Dragons in front. Max Cleworth then met George Dobson's corner with a thumping header for Wrexham's second. item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s FA Youth Cup journey came to an end on Tuesday night as they were defeated 1-0 by current holders Aston Villa. item.title: #WXMANORAK | Wrexham AFC 2-1 Portsmouth
item.description: Wrexham dug deep to follow up their spectacular win over Ipswich Town with a hard-fought victory over Portsmouth at the STōK Cae Ras. The #WxmAnorak brings you the details that matter after the ultimate game of two halves. Sam Smith marked his 275th league match with a well-judged header to put us in the lead, while Max Cleworth scored the second, his first since he scored late on in a 1-1 home draw with Blackburn Rovers last November. item.title: INTERNATIONAL CALL-UP | Wrexham AFC Academy scholar Connor Thorley named in Cymru Under-18 squad
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce that Academy scholar Connor Thorley has been selected for Cymru Under-18 duty. Thorley made the trip to South Wales straight after starting in the historic FA Youth Cup Fifth Round tie against Aston Villa on Tuesday night.
